results.title: GT40: The Road to Spa
results.overview: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, take a front-row seat to one of the most gruelling classic endurance races in the world as the sport’s most fearless drivers push themselves to the limit for the Spa 6 Hours. On a battleground infamous for its unpredictable weather, dramatic elevation changes, and unforgiving corners, who will defy the odds to cement their place in racing history?

results.title: Supernova
results.overview: Supernova is a live album by the Egyptian rock band Cairokee, presented through a short film structured as an imaginary talk show interview. Hosted by Mahmoud Saad and directed by Mahmoud Azab, the film interweaves live performances of the album's songs with interview segments, creating a narrative framework that explores the band's music and artistic journey through a fictional television program.

results.title: The Blue Buffoon
results.overview: In the wake of unexpected and, frankly, unearned success, a moronic young rapper agrees to allow a British documentary crew to capture the debauchery of his day-to-day life.

results.title: Throwback
results.overview: A woman reflects on her past while coming to terms with her life through the reflection of her younger self.

results.title: Rakta Golapa
results.overview: A woman investigates her husband's apparent suicide shortly after their arranged marriage, aided by police and her father-in-law. As clues emerge that seem to explain his death, a shocking discovery reveals a sinister truth beneath.

results.title: Central Market
results.overview: In the unhealthy environment of a downtown market, people are disappearing without a trace. An air of mystery surrounds the Central Market, until the real reason behind the events is revealed.

results.title: Clarity
results.overview: Short film screened at Chicago Horror Film Festival 2025 about a woman in recovery from addiction using a mindfulness app.

results.title: In Lieu of Flowers
results.overview: In the wake of Megan's sudden passing, her best friends Frances and Taylor work together to honor her wishes to remove any contraband items from her bedroom in efforts to preserve her image to her mourning parents. Confronted by conflicting perceptions of Megan and approaches to grief, Frances and Taylor wrestle with the question: Will they remain friends without her?

results.title: Sandal Jepit No. 10
results.overview: Akbar, a seemingly ordinary man, is taken into custody and interrogated regarding a serial murder case. From inside the room, he piece by piece reveals the timeline, underlying motives, and complex criminal plot through voice and narration alone.

results.title: Malik
results.overview: When betrayal threatens everything he holds dear, Malik embarks on a relentless journey fueled by revenge, honor, and justice.

results.title: Sawtooth Mountain
results.overview: Three college students get entangled in a horrifying ordeal after booking a Bigfoot-themed cabin run by two paranormal-obsessed brothers.

results.title: Jason's Box
results.overview: What happens when an experienced climate scientist becomes an activist? In Greenland, scientist Jason Box and his local colleagues are launching a radical project to raise global awareness.

results.title: X-Communicado
results.overview: A mute emissary with a mysterious past must transport a damaged soul to the netherworld before demons can claim it as one of their own.

results.title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
results.overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

results.title: Glow With The Flow
results.overview: Carrying her late wife’s final wish, 70-year-old Lucy returns to Hong Kong and meets 20-year-old Ellen, finding unexpected solace as they navigate grief, longing, and a fleeting connection.

results.title: Star Detective Pretty Cure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and The Pair's Secret
results.original_title: 映画名探偵プリキュア！ ⠀不思議な庭と2人の秘密
results.overview: When mysterious creatures known as Damedame begin causing trouble, young detective Anna and her friends are called upon to investigate a strange new phenomenon: valuable objects marked with an X suddenly stop working. Their investigation takes an unexpected turn when a fairy named Rain asks them to protect a girl named Karin from the Damedame.  Rain leads the detectives to Karin’s beautiful, dreamlike garden, where they meet Karin and Alan, a fairy who watches over her. As Anna and her friends grow closer to Karin and begin uncovering the garden’s secrets, the Damedame suddenly appear there as well. What are the mysterious Damedame, and what secret lies hidden within Karin’s garden?

results.title: Pièce touchée
results.overview: Arnold's source material is a piece of footage from the 1950s, eighteen seconds long and very typical for the period. A quiet take: A living room, a woman in an armchair. Her husband opens the door, kisses her, then moves out of the picture accompanied by a camera pan, his wife follows after him. In Arnold's film the sequence takes 16 minutes. Cadre by cadre, it becomes an exciting tango of movements. But Pièce Touchée is more than just a matter of forms; The reflections, distortions and delays it displays challenge cinema's stable system of space and time.

results.title: Der korrekte Diener und die Silberlöffel-Affäre
results.original_title: Der korrekte Diener und die Silberlöffel-Affäre
results.overview: Westphalia around 1900. Hermann-Josef starts his service in House Kummerveldt. After graduating from servant’s school with top grades, he wants only one thing: to serve properly. The less he can be smelled, heard or seen, the better: that’s the Baron’s housekeeper Miss Racket’s rule.
